summary: Phase 8 testing (ZEE crossings, waypoint-anchored anchorages, 50 NM marina corridor). Backend: 10 pytest cases passed / 1 skipped (destructive POST build skipped) in /app/tests/test_phase8_zee_anchorages.py. All ZEE assertions verified exactly (116 crossings, 13 unique territories, detection_method=shapely, ordered crossings with full field set, french_only=27 crossings / 13 codes all matching territories.json, trigger-formalities idempotent: 13 detected, triggered=[], skipped_uptodate=13). Anchorages endpoints (GET /api/anchorages, /count, /build/status, /api/export/anchorages.geojson with Content-Disposition) all 200 and well-formed. /api/marinas/build/status running=false. /api/formalities = 13 items, all status 'ia', all with non-empty sources, no _id leak. Frontend: Formalities ZEE section, summary '116 crossings . 13 FR territories', 116 numbered rows with FR flags + globes for foreign EEZs, zee-trigger-btn -> '0 generation started . 13 already up to date' all verified. Marinas anchorages-toggle + anchorages-count (currently 0) toggle on/off cleanly. Audit view: corridor toggle checked by default, both scan buttons visible (not clicked). Projects mode, route on map in all 3 modes, EN/FR translation of new labels (EEZ crossings / ZEE traversees, Show anchorages on the map / Afficher les mouillages) all OK. ONE CRITICAL INFRA ISSUE FOUND: the background anchorage build does not survive a backend reload and persists nothing until the very end - the running build was destroyed during this session.

critical.issue: Build progress is 100% volatile. build_anchorages() keeps state only in an in-memory BuildState and writes to Mongo ONLY after ALL 159 points are fetched (anchorages.py L369-380). uvicorn runs with --reload on /app/backend, so ANY file touch in /app/backend (incl. adding a test file under /app/backend/tests) restarts the process, silently kills the ~1h Overpass build, resets status to running=false/progress=0/total=0/logs=[] and leaves anchorages count at 0. This happened twice during this session: the build that was at 41/159 died at 18:20, and a second one died on the following reload. Current state: NO build running, anchorages total=0. Needs (a) --reload-exclude for tests/ (or reload-dir limited), (b) incremental per-bbox persistence into the anchorages collection, (c) build state persisted in Mongo so status survives restarts.

minor.issue: Returns 200 and starts a fresh full Overpass crawl with no confirmation/guard when no build is running; combined with the volatile state above, an accidental call restarts an expensive ~1h crawl from scratch. Consider a resume/force flag.
N+1 Mongo round-trips (find_one + replace_one per doc) instead of bulk_write with upsert on dedup_key.
logs_tail is empty after a backend restart (in-memory only), so the UI shows no history for an already-completed compute. Cosmetic but same volatility root cause.

integration_issues.issue: No loading state: while GET /zee/crossings is in flight, the panel renders the misleading text 'Not computed yet - detect the EEZs crossed by the route.' The catch block in fetchZee() also swallows every error silently (setZeeError never set on GET failure), so a real API failure is indistinguishable from 'not computed'. Data does appear correctly after ~1s.

audit-anchorages-summary / progress X/159 could not be observed because the backend build was killed (see backend CRITICAL). Not a frontend defect per se, but the panel shows no 'last build interrupted' indication when a build dies mid-way - status silently reverts to idle with 0 anchorages.

issues: The 116-row crossings list is confined to a very short scroll box (~4 rows visible) - consider a taller max-height or a 'show all' affordance
Foreign EEZ rows show untranslated English geonames ('Portuguese Exclusive Economic Zone') in FR mode - acceptable (official MarineRegions names) but inconsistent with the localized UI

critical_code_review_comments: anchorages.py: build_anchorages accumulates all candidates in memory and only persists after the final dedup - a 1h crawl yields nothing if the process restarts. Persist per-batch.
BuildState is process-local; /build/status is therefore unreliable across reloads and cannot detect a crashed build (running flips to false with no error set).
FormalitiesPanel.js L56-61: `catch (_) {}` hides all GET /zee/crossings errors; no loading flag distinguishes 'in flight' from 'not computed'.
server.py is 2337 lines and marinas.py 1149 lines - both exceed the 700-line guideline and should be split into routers/modules.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the lost anchorage build: uvicorn is started by supervisor with `--reload` and watches the whole /app/backend tree; the anchorage build runs as an in-process asyncio background task holding all state (progress, logs, candidate list) in memory and only writes to Mongo after the last of 159 Overpass queries. Any file change under /app/backend (my initial pytest file creation at 18:20, confirmed by 'WatchFiles detected changes in tests/test_phase8...Reloading' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log) restarts the worker, the task is cancelled, no data is persisted, and /api/anchorages/build/status reports a clean idle state with error=null - so failures are undetectable. Mitigation: exclude tests/ from reload watching, persist candidates incrementally, and store build state in Mongo. Secondary note: because the state had already reset, my POST /api/anchorages/build returned 200 (not 409) and started a fresh crawl, which was then also cancelled by the next reload; no further write calls were made.
